subject: Long story
body: Hello, I have been shopping with you for years and I usually have no complaints, so please bear with me while I explain everything from the start. Last month I ordered a coffee machine, two sets of mugs and a gift box for my sister's birthday. The coffee machine arrived first, which was great, and the mugs came a few days later in a separate package, which was a little confusing because the website said everything would ship together. The gift box took almost two weeks, and by then the birthday had passed, but my sister loved it anyway so that part is fine. I also want to mention that the delivery driver was very polite and even waited while I found my keys. I tried calling your phone line twice but the wait was over forty minutes both times, so I gave up. Your chat bot kept sending me links to the returns page, which is not what I needed. I am not trying to return anything. The real problem, and the reason I am writing, is that when I checked my bank statement this morning I saw that I was charged twice for the coffee machine, two separate payments of $249 on the same day. Please refund the duplicate payment.
